t: 一场强烈的地震袭击了现代意大利弗里利的南阿尔卑斯地区,给远至罗马的建筑物造成了相当大的破坏.
te: A strong earthquake strikes the South Alpine region of Friuli in modern Italy, causing considerable damage to buildings…
dz: 一场强烈的地震袭击了现代意大利弗里利的南阿尔卑斯地区,给远至罗马的建筑物造成了相当大的破坏.
de: A strong earthquake strikes the South Alpine region of Friuli in modern Italy, causing considerable damage to buildings as far away as Rome.
